label: CommandFile
description: A file containing commands to be executed on an experiment node.

label: CommandFileBootstrap
description: A command file for bootstrapping an experiment node.

label: CommandFileCopy
description: A command file for copying data to an experiment node.

label: CommandFileLooped
description: A command file that iterates over an array of parameters.

label: CommandFileReset
description: A command file for resetting an experiment node.

label: CommandFileSetup
description: A command file for setting up an experiment node.

label: Experiment
description: An experiment conducted in a research infrastructure.

label: ExperimentNode
description: An experiment node of a research infrastructure.

label: LoopRun
description: A single run of a looped command file.

label: OSImage
description: An operating system image booted on an experiment node.

label: bootParameters
description: List of boot parameters

label: bootedImage
description: Link to the booted image

label: bootstrapCommands
description: Links to invoked bootstrap commands

label: copiedData
description: Links to copied data if included in the crate

label: destinationPath
description: Destination path of the data to be copied

label: energyMeasurements
description: Links to energy measurement data

label: executedCommands
description: Executed commands on the experiment nodes
range: CommandFile CommandFileBootstrap CommandFileCopy CommandFileLooped CommandFileReset CommandFileSetup

label: executedOn
description: Experiment node executing the command

label: experimentController
description: Software or tools used for the experiment management and execution

label: experimentNodes
description: Experiment nodes that are part of the experiment

label: experimentWorkflow
description: Link to a file that describes the experiment workflow

label: hardware
description: Link to a hardware file of the experiment node

label: includedOSImages
description: OS images that are part of the experiment

label: invokedBy
description: If the command is invoked by a parent command

label: invokedCommands
description: Links to invoked subcommands

label: loopRuns
description: Links to the individual loop runs

label: recursiveCopy
description: If the data is copied recursively

label: resultData
description: Links to result data

label: runOfLoopedCommand
description: Link to the looped command file

label: setupCommands
description: Links to invoked setup commands

label: sourcePath
description: Source path of the data to be copied

label: status
description: Return code or link to the status file

label: stderr
description: Link to the stderr file

label: stdout
description: Link to the stdout file

label: supplementaryData
description: Links to additional data that is relevant to the experiment

label: topology
description: Link to a network topology file of the experiment node

label: variableSet
description: Link to a variable set file

label: visualizedTopology
description: Link to a visualized network topology file of the experiment node
